items.title: JPMorgan cuts Nike to Underweight, sees EPS well below consensus
items.summary: Investing.com -- JPMorgan downgraded Nike to Underweight from Neutral in a note Tuesday, warning investors that the financial impact of the company's turnaround decisions will linger far longer than the Street expects, pressuring earnings through fiscal 2028.
